notes.title: Announcement: Sector Unknown - A Sci-Fi cRPG
notes.notes:
As one of the late developers brought on to fix some of the bugs on ACS (and a fan of the game as well, I completed it three times), I would like to take a moment and announce my next game, a cPRG titled Sector Unknown.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2734270/Sector_Unknown/

After creating quite a few strategy games as an indie (and mostly solo) developer, I decided, perhaps quite insanely, to create an cRPG instead. This is the genre that I find myself playing and enjoying the most, from classics such as Baldur’s Gate 2, Fallout 2, Fallout New Vegas, Knights of the Old Republic, Mass Effect, to more contemporary games such as Pillars of Eternity, Outer Worlds, Colony Ship, Trudograd, Underrail, and Encased. In short, I really, really like RPGs, and especially ones that use an isometric angle of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915433/3374af1c0cc528a1be0d896da5acbaa0f34aca43.png[/img]

Sector Unknown is sort of my love letter to both the classics and the contemporaries. I think I’m better suited for telling a story than number crunching strategy games (as evidenced by my mixture of reviews in that genre).

After three years working part-time (well almost full time) on the systems, the game is close to complete on features (movement, inventory, party management, quests, dialogue, crafting, combat, itemization, space flight, etc). I’m aiming to have a demo for the game completed in a month or so. It’s close to completion now, but I’m still not happy with the tutorial level. What I do not want is for it to be a barrier to entry like the much-maligned temple tutorial level in Fallout 2 (I almost never experienced the rest of that fantastic game due to being so turned off by the temple).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915433/7a97d24f2231b65d4036fb79fdf14b05eab5419e.png[/img]

The goal for this game is to launch into Early Access. I intend to have over half of the game completed by that EA launch with full launch occurring 6-9 months after that. The idea to do an EA launch was not one taken lightly, but one thing I have found with my past launches is that just when I think a game is bug-free and ready for a seamless launch, players will find new and interesting ways to break things – leading to frantic post-launch schedule of rushing out bug-fixes and patches. I think this way is better. Launch into Early Access and take player feedback over time so that I can get everything sorted for a smooth launch after that. 

The other factor is budget. Right now, I do not have the armor or model system in place for player characters and NPCs. These are assets. This will change before Early Access as I have the models done (with no armor or clothing yet), but even after that, I suspect I will need some of the additional revenue from EA launch to finish the last 2-3 planets (as mentioned I aim to have 3-4 story planets complete for EA launch, with the first one ready for the demo in the coming month or so).

I hope people will wishlist and follow this game. It’s always been a dream of mine to create a sci-fi cRPG, and there doesn’t seem to be many on the market except for Colony Ship (which I completed three times). So I hope there’s a market for something like this, a game taking inspiration from early Bioware and some of the great current game developers on the market today.

I will continue to provide updates in the next while, including game systems, story, ideas, and more. I really look forward to people's feedback and thoughts as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915433/04f4a5cadf50db7442cbcdcb989695b69dd65135.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Update - Sitting Ducks, Medal Status, And More
notes.notes:
Another smaller update - changes can be seen below. Thanks for continued feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/04627303f63334cf3e0e7430492fa28e7ed1aca7.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Medals - You can now see the status of your medals during each mission from the objectives drop-down. This will show you how many ships you have destroyed, your mission time, and how many losses you have incurred against the requirements. 
[*]Sitting Ducks - The bug has been fixed where your ship is towed during the night. The time now skips properly to morning after the second video.
[*]Plane speed on deck increased slightly.
[*]Brooklyn Type I and Type II ships now named properly.
[*]Fixed bug with resupply order duration.
[*]Combat Box Gold card now promotes properly to next levels.
[*]Fixed bug with enemy defenses having exactly 0 HP not being valid targets. 
[*]Portrait selection in character creation has a duplicate entry or bug causing one of the portraits to need 2 clicks to change - this has been fixed.
[/list]

More to come. Will keep everyone posted.

Thanks!

notes.title: Game Update - Pause Button, Bug Fixes, And More
notes.notes:
Next round of changes can be seen below. Thanks for continued feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/08e57b3b98e8e4f164837649c3845b9c423eeb32.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Tactical Pause Button - it bothered me while playing through the game that I couldn't pause the tactical screen in order to issue commands and just think about what I wanted to do. It was a bit of a challenge with the current code and I had to dust off the ol' Photoshop, but I managed to add a pause button to the tactical screen. You will be able to issue office orders, plan missions, task crew mates and more while the game is paused. Note that pause is not available on the tutorial.
[*]Air Strike - added a button on the air strike screen to clear all cards and reset the mission. This is conjunction with the last update where previously cancelled air strikes would preserve the chosen cards.
[*]Fixed bug where camera would start sometimes beneath the carrier during mission start
[*]Fixed some incorrect text on the tutorial.
[*]Added quick save message for other languages after hitting F5 (used to not have any indication that a game was saved).
[/list]

Plan is to continue to push out smaller updates like this one.

Thanks!

notes.title: Game Update - Sandbox Movement Bug Fixed (And More)
notes.notes:
The sandbox movement bug has been fixed, plus managed to add a few more fixes and changes as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/7d079cb3e5f72009f61150c533cd65fee492bfdc.png[/img]

Here is a list of all that has now been fixed or added with this update:

[list]
[*]Fixed game-breaking bug where ship would not move in sandbox mode.
[*]Added panel showing which planes are on deck (fighter, dive, torpedo) - this can be found at the bottom-right part of the UI. I found myself getting annoyed having to count which kind of planes I had on deck at any give time, so figured this would be a good change.
[*]Fixed waypoint bug on tactical screen that sometimes crashed save games or froze ship. The waypoints are now reset if this happens.
[*]Added ability to save combat cards when cancelling airstrike. It used to be if you planned an airstrike only to find yourself out of range for pickup, you would cancel it and have to re-do all the cards again. That drove me crazy. This fixes that. 
[*]Fixed pixelated medal sprites.
[*]Add quick save notification. I like to know when hitting f5 that the game is actually saving. Note this has not been localized yet. Coming soon. 
[*]Fixed save indexing bug.
[*]Order of saves now shown starting from newest to oldest. 
[/list]

More to come. 

Now that I know my way a bit more around the project, I will be posted smaller and more incremental changes as listed in my forum thread. Pause button for the tactical map is slated for the next update, along with a few others.

Hope you enjoy! I'm going to do another sandbox run myself.

notes.title: Announcement - Game Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
I’m Damon from Creative Storm Entertainment. Not to be confused with CreativeForge Games. A bit about myself: I'm the designer/developer of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/442500/Age_of_Gladiators/]Age of Gladiators[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/972010/Raiders_Forsaken_Earth/?curator_clanid=33023719]Raiders! Forsaken Earth[/url] series, as well as being a co-designer/developer on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1696080/Deadwater_Saloon/]Deadwater Saloon[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/50f5dc7036ec578019d86ea4462f01539346db04.png[/img]

As Gambit Games is no more, I’ve been asked by CreativeForge to come in and help fix some of the bugs and make improvements to the game. Note that I am actually a fan of the game as well and have played the campaign to completion twice now (50+ hours on Steam), with 72% of achievements earned (a couple elude me like Purple Heart – I guess I just can’t stand seeing my crew members die).

One thing to note is that I have not played the sandbox mode as of yet, but plan on doing so soon. I understand there are some game breaking bugs there.

My strategy is to be transparent and push out series of smaller, but more frequent updates instead of larger and potentially more game-breaking ones. To my knowledge, the game hasn't received a patch since June of 2022. I intend to change that. In doing so, I'm likely going to forego some of the previously-promised visual changes (ocean color and foam, for example) and focus instead on what I think are more important gameplay impediments that need fixing.

I can't promise I'll get all the bugs fixed right away, but I'll listen and do my best.

These are some of the changes I have come up with from my gameplay:

[list]
[*]Add a Pause button
[*]Save system is still broken (slots disappear when using scroll bar)
[*]Saves do not work sometimes during missions – I intend to identify and fix this.
[*]Panel showing which planes are on deck at any given time (fighter, dive, torpedo) – I grew weary of counting how many of each plane type I had before planning airstrikes and think a quick UI addition can fix this problem.
[*]Show how many (planes on deck/planes required for mission) in launch rollover (instead of just how many planes required) – there have been too many times I’ve rolled one too many torpedo bombers and clogged up the deck during mission critical times.
[*]Health status UI bar on carrier (sections damaged / sections critical)
[*]Remove air strike not finding any targets – this one drives me crazy. If I recon an area and plan an airstrike, I find it frustrating when there are no targets found during the strike.
[*]Save attack cards – I would like to explore the ability to save a particular attack and use it again instead of having to remember which cards make for my most effective attacks. 
[*]Remove random injuring of crew members (I find it aggravating when my crew members slip on wet decks and get critically injured)
[*]Faster airplane movement on decks – not sure about this one but would like to explore it a bit more.
[*]Add quick save notification – when I hit the f5 key, I sometimes am unsure if it actually saved.
[*]Duplicate ship abilities can be used – not sure if this will be too game-breaking and overpowering or not, but I would like to maybe consider bringing too or more of the same escort ships on a mission and being able to use their abilities even while the other one is on countdown. I suspect this one won’t be viable though.)
[*]Add Save message after successful save on the save/load screen
[*]Check sandbox mode for any bugs
[*]Review tutorial
[*]Add periodic auto-saves to the game, say every 24 hours or so.
[/list] 

Some of these may not be viable, but I wanted to run them past the community. 

As mentioned before, I want to forego some of the aesthetic changes and focus on the game-breaking problems as well as some of the above quality of life changes first.

Thanks!

notes.title: Hello Admirals!
notes.notes:
We know you've been waiting patiently and looking for news about what's going on with ACS. I come to you with information that is still as fresh as a new telegram. First of all, we thank you very much for your interest and that you have not left our ship. 

Unfortunately, the prolonged break in communication was impossible to jump through - we tried to assure you that the game will continue to improve. Still, as you have noticed, we needed time to give you more information. We want to assure you that the project has not been abandoned. The truth is that there have been some changes in the team, and we need time to adjust our schedule. 

We have been looking for the right people to meet the tasks set before them, from fixing bugs to further developing the game. We are currently in the reorganization phase and preparing materials to implement minor and significant improvements to the game. 

The new team is collecting all the comments that have been reported so far and has already undertaken to fix them, but we would still like to ask you to be patient for a while because, unfortunately, the latest update will appear in at least two months. If you want to give us more feedback, please feel free to channel #bugs on our discord or email devs@creativeforge.pl (Player.log and player-prev.log, are located in %appdata%..\LocalLow\GambitGamesStudio\AircraftCarrierSurvival <-- just type it into explorer)

notes.title: DevLog #7 Campaign Mission Variety
notes.notes:
[b]Hi! Today we’ll talk about the campaign. [/b]
Previously there were only three missions available. Those who played the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493800/Aircraft_Carrier_Survival_Prologue/]demo or the prologue[/url] surely remember the invasion of Port Moresby on the Coral Sea. 
You had to navigate around enemy strike groups in order to reach a strategic position and stop the enemy troopships before they invaded the island. A time game was challenging and provided some extra depth to the objective. It was not only about targeting and sinking enemy ships. Positioning and prioritising targets played a role too. We wanted to have more missions such as this one, but even more creative and fun. Let me tell you about a couple examples.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/c10d0954881220c97f81272b472d474cba55f17b.gif[/img]

[b]Sea Battle[/b]
The campaign will be divided into four chapters. We wanted to end the chapter with a bang so one of the final missions happens amidst the entire naval battle. Dozens of ships on both sides fight each other over the large sea area. Your goal is to assist your allies and eliminate the key targets or provide enough firepower to tip the scales of victory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/a94634a35525a8cec3fa097a860cf00e3432a0da.gif[/img]

In order to illustrate the progress, we implemented a mechanic which allows non-carrier ships to bombard each other and cause damage. The remaining forces on both sides are visualised on a two-coloured progress bar. Once any end of this bar goes down to zero, the battle is over and the losing side is considered overwhelmed and must retreat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/9ec757ea8f0f3ed08f8625543982be32dd8a401c.gif[/img]

[b]Rescue Mission[/b]
What if there are people awaiting rescue, enemies are still nearby and we are the only major force in the area? This is the foundation of one of the missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/b99bb601529a0658aa690f7e4b32caa3d1751002.gif[/img]

There are lifeboats with people awaiting rescue around the map. They are running out of drinking water and strength to stay afloat. You can split your forces and arrange for rescue missions, but then you will become an easy target for enemies that may still be around.

notes.title: DevLog #6 A Sandbox Mode is coming to ACS!
notes.notes:
[b]Response to Your Feedback[/b]
In response to the community feedback, we decided to add a sandbox mode to the full version of Aircraft Carrier Survival. Apart from the historically inspired campaign, you will be able to fight over the Pacific without any restraints. The sandbox mode will allow you to take part in hundreds of small encounters with different objectives, enemies and terrain. You will be able to advance your Admiral and crew beyond the regular campaign progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/6ac4327751fb986e8f99454bb3270d014ef2fc2c.gif[/img]

[b]Red Waters[/b]
While in the sandbox mode, you can track the state of the war by looking at the range of Red Waters. It’s a new mechanic that we are sure you will have plenty of fun playing around with. Red Waters are parts of the Pacific currently occupied by the Japanese forces. You can expect missions on Red Waters to be more challenging and with more valuable rewards. Sailing on Red Waters is very dangerous - encounters with major Japanese forces are sometimes unavoidable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/9449de6476d6099989d873bb10e61dbec2eb01ae.gif[/img]

The range of Red Waters will dynamically change throughout the game - your victories will influence the area and move the front lines in favour of the USA, while other events and failures will push it the other way.

[b]Pacific Map Management[/b]
The sandbox mode will feature a lot of gameplay outside of the regular battle map. A whole layer of additional management was added. You will have to plan the course of your strike group over the ocean with regard to remaining time, available resources, planes, people and many other factors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/a8e59da6e54df838e58724017ad0c7ef5ccb1bfe.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/4729653e23902bc82abc3ddf7014c874d38fb406.gif[/img]

See you later!

notes.title: DevLog #5 New Carriers!
notes.notes:
Hi! In today’s devlog we'll talk about aircraft carriers… literally! Up to this day, there was only one aircraft carrier available in the game - [b]CV-3[/b] inspired by USS Saratoga. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/4bf6eb4bdbd387720e733dc0203e15f325fdfcb9.gif[/img]

It only had two elevators, a relatively thin deck and not that much space on the island. Whether in campaign or in the Sandbox mode, you now can upgrade to CV-5 and later on to CV-9. Let’s talk about their strengths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/1f00d56a3d1b106a93fbf02b5de397cd452977e8.gif[/img]

[b]CV-5[/b]
Inspired by USS Yorktown - a magnificent weapon of war - modernized and upgraded in almost every aspect when compared to the CV-3. Upgrading to CV-5 in the game gives a lot of benefits:
Additional aircraft elevator ensure much faster deployment of planes
New Island room grants access to three game-changing switches
A bunch of minor but useful upgrades!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/fac6f9722d3f63c545e89c8a3e1e5d7faf56fa26.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/d1b2eaca28fe9b6807968775f0cd63dd2c48ca1e.gif[/img]

[b]CV-9[/b]
An Essex Class inspired colossus. Upgrading to this one enables you as an Admiral to dominate the ocean. CV-9 is better in almost every way than its predecessors, but not for free. The maintenance needed for this beast of a carrier is enormous. Make sure you have a lot of crew teams available and your damage control tactics are on point! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/a4c3c9e08bad96d572931a41a32dc942bbdfe729.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/2b0c296a740b34a3c0abffd81d9b0768b76773b1.gif[/img]

We won’t spoil all the fun by listing out features through. Get it in the game and see for yourself!

notes.title: Dev log #4 - Crew Management and Defence
notes.notes:
[b]Crew and Defence[/b]
In this dev log, we will take a look at the crew members working on your aircraft carrier and how to manage them. These people keep your entire operation running, but assigning them to do the right tasks will make a huge difference in how quickly things are done on the ship. We will also go into the topic of defence - a crucial tool in preventing damage from oncoming attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/d09cdf47f4d7b64a58bbf3f3b15a8fafed6b1499.gif[/img]

[b]Crew Management[/b]
Managing crew is simple - in the crew management menu, you will see crew units, represented with portraits. Each unit consists of about 100 men. As long as these units are healthy, you can drag and drop them to assign them to different department slots. Each unit provides efficiency to their department, and each department is responsible for different functions. Assign units to the departments where you want the biggest boost, but keep in mind that they will need time to transfer to a new department - so plan ahead! In addition, each unit has specialties that will impact how big of a bonus their department receives. Some units are better suited for specific departments, and some of them prefer to work alone or in a full team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/35392c7d874762704836c54f008a3edef26986b8.gif[/img]

In addition, each unit has specialties that will impact how big of a bonus their department receives. Some units are better suited for specific departments, and some of them prefer to work alone or in a full team.

[b]Defence[/b]
Preparing the carrier’s defences in time is the key to surviving enemy attacks. The amount of defence points your fleet has at the moment of attack is compared to the enemy’s attack power. If you match it or exceed it - you’re very unlikely to take damage. But, if your defence is lower than the attack power, you better brace for impact - things are about to get dangerous! Your defence points can be increased in several ways.

	You can assign crew units to man Anti-Aircraft Gun stations, just as you would any other department. The number of slots available in the AA section depends on how well your carrier is equipped - you can upgrade your ship to add more of them. With a well-prepared AA section, enemy planes will have a much harder time hitting your carrier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/6a22177e4acee43e2d9f517a6bd286f36592074a.gif[/img]

	When preparing for a mission, you get to select the types of ships that will accompany you in your naval escort. You can choose to stack your fleet with Cruisers - each group of them will add defence points passively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/c5b9181a5d613c62070930417823ad7a55f6f09b.gif[/img]

	Another way to gain defence points is by using your officers in the carrier’s island. Assigning an officer to the Combat Information Center will provide you with a point of defense, but that's not all - you can also issue an order for your naval escort to enter defensive position, allowing better protection from attackers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/1c7f4780ee3707cdc8d6103d4f56e721ec58bfc5.gif[/img]

If that’s not enough, you can always launch a Combat Air Patrol mission - this way a group of your best fighter planes will circle the area around the carrier, protecting from attacks and keeping an eye out for submarines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/501e3f8edaa8a9b47ed419109c403f3f9680eaea.gif[/img]

That is all for now. Keep an eye out for more exciting updates and news!

notes.title: Dev log #2 - Intermission
notes.notes:
In the Dock
Let’s talk about upgrades and progression. The Second World War was a time of rapid technological progression. We prepared a system with that in mind. You'll be able to customise and upgrade most aspects of your carrier and eventually even unlock other carrier classes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/b6f170fbccd382c6256d55bdfbcd857dde03d76c.gif[/img]

Resources
Each level of the game gives you the opportunity to earn a certain amount of Command Points (CP) and Upgrade Points (UP). 

CP’s represent the experience your people gained. You can use it to advance and specialise your crew teams and decorate your officers.

UP’s represent technological advancement and can be spent on upgrading the carrier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/b246aa7348cfdf61f3dd05ec253ebca6998a41ea.gif[/img]

Aircraft
The planes you take on the carrier can also be upgraded. With enough UP’s you can change their base model to a more advanced one. We will not reveal which models are going to be available in the game yet, but you can write your guesses in the comments!

Upgrading planes will increase their potency and safety in combat, which makes them one of the most important upgrades to make.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/865409051577220db017cd858ee15e96b04366e9.gif[/img]

Task Force
You’ll be able to modify the Task Force around the carrier and increase it in size. Each ship chosen for the Task Force in the dock menu will be represented as the entire squadron of ships on the open sea. All choices regarding the Task Force composition will have a very strong impact on the gameplay. Ship types chosen in the intermission will unlock planning unique strategic operations. For example, a squadron of destroyers will allow submarine hunting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/46344587e79224c402509dcdf61540f41fda5cfb.gif[/img]

World Map
The intermission is also where you chose your next destination. We planned the game to progress in a nonlinear fashion. This means that you, as the Admiral, can choose the priority of missions and pick ones you decide are more important or grant better advantages for the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/c658c4c63393b388bddd580631272f06e84caf19.gif[/img]


That’s it for today. This and much more is now available on the intermission screen of the game. Feel free to share your thoughts & ideas in the comments and see you next time!

notes.title: Dev log #1 - Officers and Island
notes.notes:
Today we would like to introduce the Island - a command centre where all tough decisions are being made and where you can find your elite personnel. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/d4db313e777a9b8c479a92012508712fb9938483.gif[/img]

[b]Management[/b]

You will assign your trusted people to various rooms - each unlocking different bonuses and allowing access to different orders.

On the surface, the officer management may seem very simple - assign your people in order to ensure the high efficiency of departments. Obviously more experienced officers will provide higher bonuses. Each room is responsible for different sections of the carrier and assigning an officer will boost the section's performance. There is, however, a lot more to it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/e93af724a71499d34423d39c1f1da21cda04947d.gif[/img]
 
Not all officers can be assigned everywhere on the Island. It is important to have both aircraft officers and navy officers on the rooster. Each room on the island is described as “AIR” or “NAVY”. Officers can be assigned only to rooms they specialise in which must be taken into account during the recruitment process.

[b]Admiral[/b]
Then, there’s the admiral. The admiral is a special character that you can customise at the start of the game and develop over time. He’s unique in a sense that he can work in both AIR and NAVY rooms which means he can close the gap in your rooster - but only one thing at the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/dbeca2e43ca12168217d18f72d21514164fe016f.gif[/img]
  
[b]Orders[/b]
Finally and perhaps most importantly, each assigned officer counts either towards AIR or NAVY focus and allows you to issue special orders. Different orders require different distribution of officers between AIR and NAVY rooms. For example, there’s the carrier resupply order used to engage this crucial operation or the defensive order used to assume defensive position against known incoming attacks.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/942278512803042ea965571dabf055078e2d2899.gif[/img]

Your officers are not machines - they will tire and require rest. Send them to Officers’ Quarters when they’re exhausted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/7f2472fcba843e9feb3c6516f66f52396296cb87.gif[/img]

Officers will become your most trusted companions during dangerous missions on the Pacific Ocean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34590124/25b91ca66aef0826758e1335340311787d94f91d.gif[/img]

 
That's it for today’s dev log. In the upcoming days, we will cover damage control, flight deck operations, defending the task force, preparing tactical missions and much more. Stay tuned!

[b]Write a short mission/story, inspired by real-world war 2 aircraft carriers operations or create
completely fictional operation. Think what type of mission would you like to see in [/b][b]ACS[/b] [b]and write it down.[/b]


[b]MISSION DESCRIPTION:[/b]
Short description of conditions and orders that player receive, before the start of the story.

[b]PLOT:[/b]
Up to 10 events that can branch or be removed if other occur.
Here you write the plot and all the major twist that can happen along the way.

[b]REWARDS:[/b]
For best three entries, the Steam key for CFG GAME
From the best three entries, the community will vote for the grand winner. That person will receive a special place in ACS credits section and we will try to implement winner mission idea into the game.


[b]
STORY CONTEST RULES[/b]
CONTEST STARTS 09.10.2019 contest submission ending 1.11.2019. 

[b]HOW TO ENTER:[/b] Entries must be received by 11:59 p.m. GMT on the last day of the contest. 
In order to enter the contest please send an email to [u][b]asc@creativeforge.pl[/b][/u]
sending a story or a link to your public document (according to your preferences)
Please include in email information
If you agree to contact you via respond email or a different way of contact.

[b]PRIZES: [/b] Prizes vary, three top entries will receive a game developed by CreativeForge Games S.A. For the grand winner, there will be an additional reward. We will put the winner designed mission into the ACS. Additionally, that person name will get a special place in the credits section.

[b]WINNER SELECTION: [/b] Three winners will be selected by a committee of CreativeForge Games S.A. employees based on creativity and uniqueness of the entries. From those three winners, The grand winner will be selected by the community in the voting on the discord channel. Voting will take place, one week after the contest submission end date. 

[b]ELIGIBILITY: [/b] The contest is open to all that are at least 18 years old. Employees of CreativeForge Games S.A. are not eligible to participate. Be joining and sending your entry you give the right to CFG to publish your submission on the ACS forum and discord channel for the final voting. Discord channel: https://discord.gg/kkCwKJA

[b]GENERAL TERMS: [/b] No transfer of a prize to a third party is permitted, and prize may not be redeemed for cash value.  To receive a game award you will need a working steam account. All entrants, as a condition of entry, agree to be bound by these Official Rules and the decisions of the judges. 

[b]WINNER NOTIFICATION:[/b]  Winners will be notified via email and on the ACS discord channel. Prizes will be delivered after discord final voting for the grand winner.
